excerpt: NEXT is a new experiment to search for neutrinoless double beta decay using a radiopure high-pressure xenon gas TPC, filled with 100 kg of Xe enriched in Xe-136 ... approved to start data taking at the Laboratorio Subterráneo de Canfranc (LSC), Spain, in 2014.
title: The NEXT experiment: A high pressure xenon gas TPC for neutrinoless double beta decay searches
